cli.help.about: Print this message or the help for a subcommand
cli.provider.add.about: Add a provider and securely read its API key from standard input
cli.provider.add.arg.client: Client that will use the provider
cli.provider.add.arg.name: Display name; the endpoint domain is used when omitted
cli.provider.add.arg.model: Codex model to write when this provider is selected
cli.provider.add.arg.secret_stdin: Read the API key from standard input instead of process arguments
cli.provider.edit.arg.name: New display name
cli.provider.edit.arg.model: New Codex model; omit to preserve the current value
cli.provider.edit.arg.secret_stdin: Replace the API key with a value read from standard input
cli.provider.switch.about: Switch the active provider for a client
cli.provider.switch.arg.client: Client whose active provider will change
cli.provider.import-current.about: Import the provider currently configured by a client

cli.mode.about: Change direct or local-proxy connection mode
cli.mode.set.about: Set the connection mode for a client
cli.mode.set.arg.client: Client whose connection mode will change
cli.status.about: Show daemon, proxy, and managed-client state
cli.doctor.about: Run configuration, security, IPC, and service diagnostics

cli.daemon.uninstall.arg.purge: Also remove hsin state, backups, and keyring entries
cli.daemon.update.about: Reinstall the service using the hsind binary next to this CLI
cli.security.import-recovery-key.arg.std: Read the recovery key from standard input
cli.security.rotate-key.about: Rotate the encryption key and re-encrypt provider credentials
cli.credential.about: Resolve a credential for Codex or Claude Code (internal)
cli.credential.arg.provider_id: Provider ID bound to the client configuration
cli.credential.arg.revision: Provider revision bound to the client configuration

settings_help: ↑/↓ select · ←/→ or enter change · esc close
settings_address_help: type IP address · enter save · esc cancel
settings_port_help: type port · enter save · esc cancel
settings_proxy_master_description: Control whether hsind's proxy listener is available. Turning it off also returns every managed client to direct mode.
settings_proxy_master_on_description: Start the proxy listener. Client proxy modes are unchanged until enabled with p on the home screen.
settings_proxy_master_off_description: Return all managed clients to direct mode, then stop the proxy listener.
settings_proxy_address_description: Proxy listening IP. Loopback, specific interface, and wildcard addresses such as 0.0.0.0 are supported. Local client configuration uses 127.0.0.1 for 0.0.0.0 and ::1 for ::. Changes apply immediately and restart the listener when enabled.
settings_proxy_port_description: Proxy listening port. Changes apply immediately and restart the listener. Valid range: 1024–65535.
settings_client_configuration_descriptio: Configure authentication for Codex and Claude Code separately, and manage their visibility and switching order in the TUI.
settings_disable_custom_auth_description: Enabling this disables the Hsin Auth proxy and reduces security. If you must enable it, also use proxy mode.
settings_disable_custom_auth_warning_pre: Enabling this disables the Hsin Auth proxy and
settings_disable_custom_auth_warning_suf: . If you must enable it, also use proxy mode.
settings_client_visibility_description: Show or hide Codex and Claude Code in the TUI. At least one client must remain visible.
settings_client_visibility_item_descript: Toggle whether this client appears in the header and participates in client switching.
settings_client_order_description: Change the order used by the header and Tab/arrow client switching.
settings_client_order_item_description: Press Enter to select this client for repositioning.
settings_client_order_moving_description: Use Up and Down to move the selected client, then press Enter to save.
settings_import_current_description: A new Provider is created only when its Base URL or API key differs from every existing Provider.
settings_mode_description: Choose whether this client connects directly to the provider or through hsin's configured proxy listener.
settings_language_description: Choose the language used by the CLI and terminal interface.
settings_direct_description: Write the selected provider endpoint and credential helper directly to the client configuration.
settings_proxy_description: Keep a stable managed endpoint in the client configuration and route requests through hsind.
settings_system_description: Follow the operating system language. Unsupported languages use English (US).
settings_zh_cn_description: Display the interface in Simplified Chinese.
